task_description: Build a complete, production-ready website called BrainFog.mov - an AI video generation platform for creating brainrot-style short-form videos. Includes landing page, pricing, auth, dashboard with video generation using Replicate API, and settings. Built with Next.js 16, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, deployable on Vercel free tier.

verification.summary: npm run build succeeds with all 13 routes (static and dynamic). npm run lint passes cleanly. Security review findings addressed (auth on API routes, password hashing, history cap, constant extraction). No automated tests as this is a greenfield UI-heavy project. Docker build skipped (target is Vercel).
